## About me
Starting May 2026, I am a postdoctoral researcher in multivariate extremes at UCLouvain under the supervision of [Anna Kiriliouk](https://akiriliouk.github.io/).

I was previously a PhD student in statistics under the supervision of Liliane Bel, Sylvie Parey and [David Métivier](https://davidmetivier.mistea.inrae.fr/). My subject was **Multisite stochastic generation of multivariate weather time series**. I used spatio-temporal statistics, Gaussian processes, parametric covariance functions, Hidden Markov models and other useful (needed !) tools to generate large samples of meteorological variables.

I was a part of the R38 team at EDF, as well as in [MIA-PS](https://mia-ps.inrae.fr/) team at [INRAE](https://www.inrae.fr/en), both located in Palaiseau.
